# Graft project — agent guide (shared CMS)

Everything is code. Content lives in MDX files; git is authoritative; the
content index is derived. If they disagree, git wins — recompile.

This package (`@andy-portfolio/content`) is the CMS for **both** site
versions: Astro (`apps/web`, live) and Next (`apps/web-next`, local archive).

- Schema: graft.config.ts (`posts`, `projects`, `case-studies`). The single
  source of truth.
- Documents:
  - content/posts/<slug>.mdx — blog bodies
  - content/projects/<slug>.mdx — frontmatter only; listed on / and /projects
  - content/case-studies/<slug>.mdx — frontmatter only; rendered at
    /case-studies/<slug>
- Images: blog assets under each app's public/blog/<slug>/; project and
  case-study images are existing public-root paths (e.g. /welup-main.png).
- Slugs are kebab-case; a frontmatter `slug:` overrides the filename.
- Project into the index: `bun run --filter=@andy-portfolio/content compile`
  (one-shot) or `graft:dev` (watch mode).
- This project uses the **static index** (`index = "static"` in graft.config):
  compile writes .graft/index.db — a SQLite artifact. No database, no env vars.
- The artifact is derived, so it is git-ignored. Dev and Vercel build compile
  this package first, then build the app.
- Astro reads with `getGraft()` in apps/web/src/lib/graft.ts and renders blog
  bodies through Astro content collections + `@astrojs/mdx`.
- Next reads with `getGraft()` in apps/web-next/src/lib/graft.ts and renders
  blog bodies with `@usegraft/sdk-next` `MdxBody`.
- Branches here are just **git branches**: each checkout compiles its own artifact.
- Studio, operational data, typed functions, and database branching need the
  Postgres tier. Adding one fails with NEEDS_DATABASE.
- Primitives: `graft add <item>` lands under graft/. Run `graft add` to list.
- Every Graft error carries a `fix` — do what it says, then retry.
